summary:
US President Donald Trump arrived in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday for a trilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Xi greeted Trump on the tarmac in a rare gesture, the first time he has personally received a foreign dignitary at an airport in more than a decade as China's leader. Xi met Putin on Wednesday and urged closer political and military ties. The three leaders are expected to meet on Thursday to address the wars in Ukraine and Iran, as well as nuclear disarmament, and analysts expect few concrete outcomes.

Bahrain and Kuwait said on Wednesday that they had repelled air attacks after US fighter jets struck an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps missile launch site on Qeshm Island, according to an American official. The conflict began with US-Israeli strikes on Iran in late February. On Tuesday, Trump said the US was taking seriously the possibility of an Iranian dirty-bomb attack on Washington, after a CNN report citing US intelligence, and Tehran called the suggestion baseless.

Democrat Mary Peltola won Alaska's Senate race on Tuesday, defeating Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan with 50.1% of the vote. Her win gives Democrats a 56-44 Senate majority and their ninth Senate flip of the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Xi greets Trump in Shenzhen ahead of trilateral summit with Putin
headlines.summary: Xi greeted Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen on Wednesday, the first time in over a decade he has personally received a foreign dignitary at an airport. The three leaders are expected to meet Thursday on Ukraine, Iran and nuclear disarmament.

headlines.title: Bahrain and Kuwait repel attacks after US strikes Iranian island
headlines.summary: Bahrain and Kuwait said they repelled air attacks after US jets struck an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island. Tehran rejects as baseless any suggestion it planned a dirty-bomb attack on Washington, which Trump said on Tuesday the US is taking seriously.

headlines.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate seat, giving Democrats 56 seats
headlines.summary: Peltola defeated Republican Dan Sullivan with 50.1% of the vote, the final outstanding midterm race. The result gives Democrats a 56-44 Senate majority and their ninth Senate flip of the midterms.

headlines.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years
headlines.summary: The Pan American Health Organization said Tuesday the US lost its measles elimination status after 26 years of continuous spread for more than a year. States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths.

headlines.title: EU proposes €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027
headlines.summary: The European Commission proposed a €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027, covering about two-thirds of Kyiv's financing needs. Ursula von der Leyen said the loan would be repaid through future war reparations by Russia.

headlines.title: Rubio says there is zero evidence tech outages are linked
headlines.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was zero information that a cascade of outages was linked to each other or to a malign actor. He suggested the rush to patch systems, whose vulnerabilities AI has exposed, may explain some failures.

headlines.title: Israeli parliament elects Matan Kahana as speaker
headlines.summary: Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana, a lawmaker from Gadi Eisenkot's party, as speaker on Tuesday. The vote is a step toward rolling back policies passed by the outgoing government led by Benjamin Netanyahu.

headlines.title: Nvidia forms national security committee after Huang's exit
headlines.summary: Nvidia created a board-level committee for national security and export control after CEO Jensen Huang resigned over extramarital affairs. The affairs allegedly included one with a Chinese intelligence asset.
